newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Energy sets up plant management.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Energy sets up plant management.

text.p: Wisconsin Energy Corp said Monday two of its subsidiaries will now manage the two main operations of the Milwaukee County Power Plant.

Wisconsin Electric will run the steam services division, while the newly created Wisconsin Thermal Energy Service unit will operate the chilled water facilities, said Wisconsin Electric. The utility completed negotiations relieving Milwaukee County of both the steam and chilled water facilities earlier this month.
Wisconsin Energy provides electrical, gas and steam service to 2.3 million people in Wisconsin and Michigan's upper peninsula.
